name: crown-blade-insights
description: Owner reports for Crown & Blade: monthly shop stats, client history and review ratings, maintained from bookings and reviews.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test build-test/test/time.test.js build-test/test/stats.test.js build-test/test/aggregate.test.js build-test/test/ratings.test.js build-test/test/backfill.test.js
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore
